No auth. The login screen draws login methods and second-factor steps that plugins provide, before anyone has signed in. Returns only enabled plugins that contribute login methods or second factors, with the fields the browser loader needs and the ids they contribute. Nothing operational: no capabilities, grants, settings or errors.
